title: Shasqi presented 2 posters at the 2025 American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting
body_markdown:
Shasqi presented two scientific posters at the 2025 American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting on April 27, 2025 in Chicago, Illinois.


View the abstracts below:


[First-in-class click chemistry-based pre-targeting of CEACAM5 tumor antigen selectively activates an MMAE payload at tumors](https://aacrjournals.org/cancerres/article/85/8_Supplement_1/342/755158/Abstract-342-First-in-class-click-chemistry-based)


[Pre-targeting with in vivo click chemistry enables preferential drug exposure in tumors versus normal tissues](https://aacrjournals.org/cancerres/article/85/8_Supplement_1/1793/756428/Abstract-1793-Pre-targeting-with-in-vivo-click)
